newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, soy mixed, wheat unchanged.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, soy mixed, wheat unchanged.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean and corn values were mixed Monday, and wheat was unchanged in quiet dealings, exporters said.
"Today (Monday) was extremely quiet," one exporter said. "We just didn't have anything going on."
The majority of world wheat business is expected to go to European dealers because the U.S. remains too expensive, exporters said.
"The futures are going to have to do their thing," an exporter said. The funds have got to cover their shorts (positions), then we'll settle down and do business."
In U.S. export business Monday, Philippine firms bought 35,000 tonnes of wheat for February arrival.
Additionaly, two South Korean firms bought 21,500 tonnes of U.S. wheat for shipment March 5 through April 5.
